title: Senior Data Scientist
description: We are seeking an experienced Data Scientist to develop production predictive models, lead analytics initiatives, and build GenAI solutions. Must be proficient in Python, SQL querying for large data lakes, Machine Learning (Scikit-Learn, XGBoost), Generative AI (LLMs, LangChain, RAG), and Power BI dashboarding for stakeholders. Experience with Docker and AWS is a plus.

title: Data Analyst
description: Looking for a high-energy Data Analyst to turn financial data into actionable insights. Strong SQL skills are essential for data extraction, joining tables, and aggregation. You will build executive dashboards in Power BI and Tableau, write Python automation scripts for data cleansing with Pandas, and present statistical analysis to leadership.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Join our AI research team deploying real-time ML systems. The candidate must have hands-on experience in Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, Deep Learning, MLflow, and advanced SQL. Exposure to Generative AI architectures, vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB), and Docker containerization is required.

title: Junior Data Scientist
description: HealthMetrics is hiring a Junior Data Scientist. Key responsibilities include querying medical records using complex SQL, building regression and classification models in Python, performing statistical hypothesis testing, and creating interactive reports using Power BI.

title: AI & GenAI Solutions Engineer
description: Build next-generation enterprise applications powered by Generative AI and Foundation Models. Strong expertise in Python, Prompt Engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, SQL data pipelines, and REST API integration with FastAPI.

title: Business Intelligence & Data Specialist
description: Responsible for delivering retail performance analytics. Must write optimized SQL queries, manage ETL pipelines, build automated Power BI / Tableau dashboards, and leverage Python for customer segmentation and demand forecasting.

title: Lead Data Scientist - NLP & LLMs
description: Driving NLP and Generative AI transformation across our product line. Deep mastery of Python, Hugging Face Transformers, LLM fine-tuning, SQL data warehouse management, and deployment with Docker and Kubernetes.

title: Data Analytics Associate
description: Entry-level opportunity for graduates with strong analytical thinking. Candidates must be fluent in SQL (subqueries, window functions), Excel advanced modeling, basic Python scripting, and Power BI report creation.

title: Full Stack React & Node Developer
description: Looking for a full stack engineer skilled in modern web stacks. Must know React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL/MongoDB, Next.js, and Docker for containerized deployments. Experience with Tailwind CSS and Git workflow is standard.

title: Frontend Engineer (React + TypeScript)
description: We are seeking a Frontend Engineer passionate about crafting pixel-perfect web apps. Key requirements: React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit / Zustand, Tailwind CSS, Responsive Design, REST APIs, and automated UI testing with Vitest/Jest.

title: Backend Python / FastAPI Engineer
description: Design and maintain high-throughput microservices. Requirements include Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL database design and query optimization, Redis caching, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Actions.

title: Full Stack MERN Developer
description: Develop full-stack web applications using MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js. Knowledge of TypeScript, Next.js, and RESTful API principles is strongly preferred. Must have solid Git and version control skills.

title: Junior Web Developer
description: Opportunity for freshers with good foundation in JavaScript, React, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Git, and REST API integration. Exposure to TypeScript is a major advantage.

title: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
description: Seeking a Cloud Engineer to manage AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes clusters, Docker containerization, Terraform Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.

title: Associate DevOps Specialist
description: Manage automated builds, container orchestration, and server monitoring. Core requirements: Linux bash scripting, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure basics, CI/CD with GitHub Actions or Jenkins, and Git.
